test.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 COVERAGE_FILE=.coverage.parallel uv run pytest --ignore=tests/plan_tooling --ignore=tests/session_setup --ignore=tests/host_sweep --ignore=tests/session_setup_pypi --ignore=tests/ask_seam --ignore=tests/dag_ui --ignore=tests/unwatched --ignore=tests/merge_policy --ignore=tests/writeback_budget --ignore=tests/run_end_hooks --ignore=tests/host_views --ignore=tests/project_store_race --ignore=tests/plan_store_assets --ignore=tests/render_diagram --ignore=tests/e2e --ignore=tests/unfinished --ignore=tests/graceful_cancel --ignore=tests/session_open_conflict --ignore=tests/manager_allowlist --ignore=tests/dispatch_bar --ignore=tests/family_scans --ignore=tests/manager_guidance --ignore=tests/plan_guidance --ignore=tests/release_pins --ignore=tests/tree_scans -m 'not reads_docs and not reads_recipes and not reads_checkouts' -n 4 --dist loadgroup --cov=orchestrator --cov-report= --cov-fail-under=0

coverage.command: rm -f .coverage && env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run coverage combine --keep .coverage.parallel .coverage.budget-gate .coverage.dispatch-bar .coverage.e2e-root .coverage.family-scans .coverage.launch-monitor-observer .coverage.manager-guidance .coverage.plan-guidance .coverage.plan-tooling-check-and-review .coverage.plan-tooling-follow-ups .coverage.plan-tooling-plan-copy .coverage.plan-tooling-plan-flow .coverage.publish-and-landing .coverage.registry-and-recipes .coverage.release-pins .coverage.tree-scans .coverage.workspace-copies && env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run coverage report
coverage.//: llmlint: ignore[external_service_suite_stays_out_of_the_affected_tier, expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] The floor is judged on every tier that measures orchestrator/, which tests/tree_scans/test_nx_cache_scope.py holds this list to, so it waits on each journey, plan-tooling and drift-gate project that measures into its own .coverage.<project name>: this combine is the floor's one enforcement, so each file it names has to exist when it runs. Each edge is a cache replay when that project's key is unchanged, and a run only when its key changed, which the diff selection already runs it for. That includes publish-and-landing:test and the session-reuse journey there that installs a released engine from PyPI. The same edge ran to the whole of orchestrator-e2e before the journeys were split, and moving the costly and external-service journeys out of the measuring tiers is a change of its own. Letting the combine skip a missing file instead would report a floor over lines nobody measured. JSON has no comment to scope this to the keys it is about.

budgets.//: llmlint: ignore[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] The launch-monitor-observer edge below is forced by the approved home of the board and lost-turn budgets, orchestrator/budgets.yaml, whose telemetry the launch-monitor-observer journeys record. It pulls that journey project into every check selecting this project: a cache replay when its key is unchanged, a full run of its launch journeys on a host with no cache entry for it. The measuring journeys import that project's launch journey, so they cannot move into a project of their own without the code they share. The dispatch-bar edge beside it is already that shape: the plan-review drift gates recording the plan-level prompt budgets are a project of their own, a few seconds of tests behind their own key.
